title: us_short_universe_candidate_artifact
description: Per-run US-short Pass1 universe candidate artifact (batch5 round-2 R2). It is the gitignored, auditable record of ONE universe fetch: every NYSE/NASDAQ ticker considered, its Pass1 inputs (price / multi-day ADV / market-cap), its eligibility verdict + reasons, and per-row provider lineage (price_source / ADV window coverage / shares source / as_of / observed_at). `summary` and `eligible_tickers` are RECOMPUTED from `rows` (the runner re-derives them and fails closed before write if they disagree), so the artifact can prove WHY a ticker entered or was cut and can be safely re-run. `decision_date` is the canonical upcoming-trading-day (§2.1) that the OUTPUT PATH binds to; `price_basis_date` is the prior settled session; `used_date` is the newest Massive trading day actually used. `adv_usd` is the multi-day AVERAGE daily dollar volume over the ADV window (NOT a single day's dollar volume) — a ticker observed on fewer than `adv_window.min_days_required` days has `adv_usd: null` (insufficient coverage → conservative, never eligible). Rows carry prices, so this artifact is written under the gitignored state/ root (NOT tracked); the tracked summary keeps only counts. Schema is enforced at runtime BEFORE the atomic write (jsonschema import-or-fail-closed).

generated_at.description: When this artifact was produced (observed_at for every row).

decision_date.description: Canonical upcoming-trading-day YYYYMMDD (§2.1). The output file path binds to this.

price_basis_date.description: Canonical prior settled session YYYYMMDD (§2.1 price basis).

used_date.description: Newest Massive trading day with data actually used as the latest ADV-window day (Massive is delayed, so this may step back from price_basis_date).

calendar_verification_status.description: The frozen market-calendar data_provenance.verification_status used to resolve decision_date/price_basis_date (disclosed, not laundered).

trading_days.description: Target ADV window length in trading days (the prior over which dollar volume is averaged).

min_days_required.description: Minimum per-ticker observed days for a usable ADV; below this adv_usd is null (conservative).

observed_window_dates.description: The trading days actually fetched with data (newest-first), the real basis of the average.

rows.description: One row per considered universe ticker (ALL of them — eligible and not), the audit basis for summary.

eligible_tickers.description: Canonical tickers whose row.eligible is true (recomputed from rows; must be unique).

price.description: Newest observed close (price basis); null if no close.

price_as_of.description: The trading day the price came from (may be older than used_date for a thin name).

adv_usd.description: Multi-day AVERAGE daily dollar volume over the observed window; null when adv_days_observed < min_days_required.

shares.description: SEC XBRL free-float shares outstanding; null if absent.

status_flags_sourced.description: Round-1: const false — delisted/halted/bankruptcy/otc hardwired false (status source gated, R-USSHORT-BATCH5-PASS1-CRITICAL-STATUS-HEALTH-FAILOPEN); const-pinned (F4) so a forged status-sourced shape is rejected by the schema itself, matching the sibling batch5 schemas' self-sufficiency.

reasons.description: All failing Pass1 reasons (empty iff eligible).
